mapper.select: /* CastSlfchknMapper.retrieveSlfDeviceCntList */ SELECT ISLAND, SLF_TYPE, COUNT(PSG_FCLT_CD) AS DEVICE_CNT FROM ( SELECT B.PSG_FCLT_CD, CASE WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = 'CK' THEN 'KIOSK' ELSE B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD END AS SLF_TYPE, CASE WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = 'CK' THEN SUBSTR(B.SMLT_FCLT_NM, -3, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = 'SBD' THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, -3, 1) END AS ISLAND FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('CK', 'SBD') AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE ISLAND IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ISLAND, SLF_TYPE ORDER BY ISLAND, SLF_TYPE
